revisions.arc: arc-b7-v2 (books/book-07-void-roads/CHAPTER_ARCHITECTURE.md, editor PASS r4, Chapter 17 card)

knowledge_boundary: Cael is nineteen; ten + located anomaly. Roster SIX; physically FIVE at Lowmarch (Oryn is three days north making up her route; she left Thornwater after the circle of six). Lira one-armed (slung; load-restricted for the season).

Known to the circle: the Quieting (named); the Fallow Ring's mechanics; Cael's fragments work inside (all six know); the Compact measured quiet ground (stakes, map blanks); the first contract was written from inside and its completion report went west; the cache is what the Compact wants (B6's open dread).

Pike's ledger entry for the Fallow Ring (incomplete; crew returned) costs them a line and buys what no line records: they went in and came out, which no crew on the board has done. Teague STANDS when they come in — not a greeting; a captain marking a change before the ledger does.

The second posting: same broker (who Pike says has posted nothing else in a year), same 'instruments', a second site — the Long Stair, a day south — at three times the first price. Seln's reading (the professional's chapter-within-a-chapter): registry prose again; a price that is a lure, sized for a crew that went in once and came out; a site chosen where the poster knows six practitioners will be five bodies and one anomaly (the poster does NOT know about Cael's immunity — nobody outside the circle does). 'This isn't a contract. It's a pre-restriction inventory. They've mapped what we do inside, and they've priced a floor where we can't do it.' Karis: 'They don't know about Cael.' Seln: 'They don't need to. They want the case. The boy's the price of the case.'

The council (five voices): Lira and Brom want to walk away; Karis wants the site regardless; Seln wants to TAKE it — a trap you have read is the only instrument for reading the hand behind it: 'They'll send people. People have faces. Six years I've wanted a face.' Cael's decision line verbatim: 'Inside the circle, I'm the only one who works. They chose a floor that makes the rest of you helpless. They don't know it doesn't do anything to me.' They take it: the site is real, the pattern needs it, the trap is built on an assumption the Compact cannot know is wrong.

Teague at the door: 'You're taking the Stair contract.' 'Yes.' 'It's a bad contract.' 'Yes.' 'My crew's at Oxhollow in two days. If you're late back, we'll come look.' Cael: 'Noted.' Brom quotes Rooke once: 'doors open both ways' (he has never quoted anyone).
No theory of the sites; no 'Architect'; the faceless faction stays faceless; no letters, no Vastin.

purpose: Part 3 opens: back at Lowmarch with a standing the ledger cannot quite record, a second posting from the same broker priced as a lure, Seln's professional anatomy of a trap built on quiet ground, the book's second honest collision over walking away — lost by the leavers for the right reason — and the rival clock making a sound it has not made all book.

scene_shape.opening_state: Lowmarch, first cold. Pike's Fallow Ring entry; Teague standing; the unit's standing after the Ring. Oryn three days north.
scene_shape.pov_goal: Read the contract the way Seln reads it, decide whether to walk into a trap on purpose, and say aloud to the whole table the sentence he has never said.
scene_shape.opposition: A contract that is an inventory; the case on Seln's shoulder as the price; Lira and Brom's honest wish to walk away; Karis who would go alone.
scene_shape.turn: The posting read; Seln's anatomy (registry prose; nothing else posted in a year; the lure's size; the floor chosen; the pre-restriction-inventory line; 'They want the case.'). The council's four positions in register.
scene_shape.choice: Cael's decision and the sentence (fixed): they take it, because the site is real and the pattern needs it, and because the trap's assumption is wrong in a way the Compact cannot know.
scene_shape.outcome: Contract taken; south tomorrow; the log mid-scene: 'Priced too well. Seln says it's for the case. I say the floor's for me and they don't know it. South, tomorrow. Lira's arm is a week old. Brom says doors open both ways. He's quoting Rooke. He's never quoted anyone.'
scene_shape.closing_state: The chapter ENDS ON DIALOGUE (the previous chapter ended on the log): Teague's offer at the door, and Cael's 'Noted.' — the first time in the book he has said the word to anyone eleven lines up.

must_include: Pike's 'incomplete — instruments not recovered — crew returned' line costing a line and buying the unrecorded thing; Teague standing when they come in; the standing shown, not asserted.
The second posting as an object (same broker, same instruments, the Long Stair a day south, three times the price); Pike's 'posted nothing else in a year' unasked.
Seln's anatomy with the fixed lines verbatim (pre-restriction inventory; 'They want the case. The boy's the price of the case.'); Karis's 'They don't know about Cael.'
The council with each position in register; Seln's 'People have faces. Six years I've wanted a face.'; Cael's decision line verbatim.
The mid-scene log entry as given (with Brom quoting Rooke).
Teague's door exchange verbatim; the chapter ENDS on 'Noted.'
Oryn's absence on the page accounted for (three days north on her route); Lira's arm carried (a week old, slung).
Manuscript format: H1 '# Chapter 17 — Priced Too Well', prose only, '---' breaks, ends on the last line of prose.
plants: The trap's design (people outside the line with crossbows; the floor as disarmament) — Ch19 stages it; here only Seln's inference that they will send people.
payoffs: Ch12's 'We just told them'; Ch16's report on a desk it shouldn't reach; Ch2's rival clock (Teague stands; speaks at the door).
prohibited_outcomes: No travel to the Stair yet; no fight; no fragment use; Oryn absent.
No theory of the sites; no 'Architect'; no naming of the faction; the broker unnamed.
The chapter does not end on a log entry or an image.
No modern idiom; no feeling/growth declarations; tic caps; no metadata.
Do not use the phrase 'at the pitch' (or 'at that pitch') — it is at the book's cap already (10 uses in Chapters 1–4). Vary attribution registers with other means.

allowed: Lowmarch in first cold; the board's room and the best table; Pike's manner; the posting's paper; the council's table; Teague at the door.
Dialogue in established voices beyond the fixed lines.
Cael's interior read of the posting and of Teague.
approval_required: Any new named entity; any fact about the broker or the faction beyond Seln's inferences; any detail of the trap's mechanics beyond 'they will send people'.
forbidden: Travel; fights; theory; fragment use; a log or image ending; metadata.
